obligations.text: The creditor shall exercise reasonable diligence in obtaining such information.
To qualify as an empirically derived, demonstrably and statistically sound, credit scoring system, the system must be:

Any such system must satisfy the criteria set forth in paragraph (p)(1)(i) through (iv) of this section; if the creditor is unable during the development process to validate the system based on its own credit experience in accordance with paragraph (p)(1) of this section, the system must be validated when sufficient credit experience becomes available.
